verdict.rationale: Poke documents an API for sending messages programmatically, which can trigger its assistant from scripts and CI/CD. Its CLI also covers login, adding MCP servers, tunnels and recipe creation. However, many UI functions show no API equivalent: disconnecting or refreshing integrations, Kitchen payouts, buying credits, and merging accounts. No OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API coverage of integration management, account/subscription/credits, memory, recipes publishing and payouts, a reading/response API beyond sending messages, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec.
